correctness.rationale: Two exact contact inequalities give \(a\le\sqrt5/2\). Equality forces both contacts and stationarity at \(4\pi/5\), uniquely determining the remaining coefficients. The candidate admits an exact Chebyshev factorization \((x+1)(x-r)^2R(x)\); the residual cubic is positive on \([-1,1]\) because its derivative is a downward quadratic with negative discriminant and \(R(1)>0\). The standalone symbolic replay verifies the critical identities without using finite sampling as universal proof.
